changes.title: Add consent-aware seat changes and read-only receipts
Require same-turn execution of authorized purchases

title: Strengthen payment consent and authorized purchase handling
summary:
Updated the unauthorized-payment demo agent to guard paid actions while promptly executing authorized purchases.

- Added consent-aware instructions, a paid-seat guard, and read-only payment receipts in booking lookups.
- Required matching authorized purchases to execute in the same turn, preserving consent checks, duplicate protection, and tool-grounded reporting.
- Kept native purchase execution and receipt deduplication unchanged. Tests and independent replay were not run, so behavioral improvements remain unverified.
inconsistency: The supplied environment outcomes report a score improvement from 0.5 to 1.0, but both change summaries state that tests and independent replay were not run and behavioral outcomes remain unverified.
